target.title: feat(ui): search session transcripts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Sessions page could filter loaded session metadata, but it could not search text inside user and assistant messages. Operators had to leave Control UI and use a terminal to find an older conversation.

Fixes #81583.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the existing operator-scoped `sessions.search` Gateway method instead of scanning transcripts in the browser. The new control is deliberately separate from the loaded-roster filter, sends one trimmed request only on submit, caps results at 25, ignores stale responses, and disables itself when the connected Gateway does not advertise the method.

Search lifecycle is represented as a closed idle/loading/error/results state. Results retain session, role, timestamp, and escaped snippet provenance and open the matching chat.

## User Impact

Operators can now search exact user or assistant message text across the default agent's sessions directly from Sessions. The UI exposes loading, indexing, empty, error, truncated, and unavailable states, and supports Enter, Search, Retry, and Clear.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxbspby7ynw7wdkghrmw4b4s`: 51 focused Sessions UI tests passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox: 3 mocked-Gateway browser E2E scenarios passed, covering exact request parameters, no per-keystroke request, clear/research, result provenance, navigation, whitespace, stale responses, indexing retry, errors, and capability gating.
- Blacksmith Testbox: `pnpm tsgo:ui` passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox: targeted Oxlint passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors across the six TypeScript files.
- Canonical `oxfmt` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Source-blind behavior contract: all in-scope clauses passed; no findings or blockers.
- Structured autoreview: clean; no accepted or actionable findings.
